caption:
Unpopular opinion: gas going up 34% in a year should come with a warning label. ⛽
CNBC reports gasoline is up 34.2% over the past year in the latest CPI.
You notice it every single fill-up, but your paycheck never moves that fast.
What's the first thing you cut when gas jumps?
first_comment: How many miles a week do you drive just to get to work? 🚗👇
